product_overview: A NestJS backend for managing employee attendance, departures, profiles, and manager oversight in an organization. The system supports role-based access for SUPER_ADMIN and EMPLOYEE users with secure JWT authentication and PostgreSQL persistence.
core_goals: Provide secure signup and login for employees and managers
Track daily attendance with check-in and check-out workflows
Enable managers to oversee assigned employees and audit staff data
Expose employee profile and status views for self-service use
Deliver weekly and monthly attendance reports for employees and managers

features.name: Users Authentication
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, search for users, update their own profile, and delete their own account.
user_flows: POST /users/logUp with valid SUPER_ADMIN or EMPLOYEE registration data -> Receive 201 with signup response and token -> Use token for authenticated requests
POST /users/logUp with invalid or incomplete registration data -> Receive validation error response
POST /users/loginIn with valid credentials -> Receive 201 with token and user profile -> Use token to access protected endpoints
POST /users/loginIn with incorrect credentials -> Receive authentication error response
GET /users/search_Word with a valid JWT and search keyword -> Receive 200 with matched users array
GET /users/search_Word without a JWT or with an invalid token -> Receive 401/403 authorization error
PATCH /users/updateMyProfile with a valid JWT and profile changes -> Receive 200 with updated user details
PATCH /users/updateMyProfile with invalid update payload -> Receive validation error response
DELETE /users/deleteMyProfile with a valid JWT -> Receive 200 with deletion confirmation
DELETE /users/deleteMyProfile without a valid JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error

features.name: Attendance Management
features.description: Lets employees record check-in and check-out events while the system calculates lateness, early leave, and worked time.
user_flows: POST /attendance/check-in with a valid employee JWT -> Receive 201 with attendance record and calculated delay or on-time status
POST /attendance/check-in when the employee has already checked in -> Receive 409 already checked in error
POST /attendance/check-out with a valid employee JWT after check-in -> Receive 201 with updated attendance record including worked time and early leave
POST /attendance/check-out without an existing check-in record -> Receive error response indicating the attendance state is invalid
POST /attendance/check-in with an invalid or expired JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error

features.name: Manager Core Features
features.description: Provides SUPER_ADMIN users with dashboard statistics, employee assignment, auditing, weekly reports, and automatic checkout support.
user_flows: GET /managing/dashboard with a valid manager JWT and date parameter -> Receive 200 with dashboard statistics for the selected date
GET /managing/dashboard without a valid JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error
POST /managing/add-employee/:id with a valid manager JWT and employee id -> Receive 201 with updated EmployeeProfile showing the assignment
POST /managing/add-employee/:id for a non-existent employee id -> Receive 404 not found error
GET /managing/my-employees with a valid manager JWT -> Receive 200 with paginated subordinate employee profiles
GET /managing/my-employees without a valid JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error
PATCH /managing/audit-employee with valid manager JWT and audit fields -> Receive 200 with audited profile details
PATCH /managing/audit-employee with invalid salary, shift, or status data -> Receive validation error response
GET /managing/weekly-report with a valid manager JWT and startDate -> Receive 200 with employee attendance lists for the week
POST /managing/auto-checkout with a valid manager JWT -> Receive 201 with automatic checkout report for open shifts

features.name: Employee Profile and Reports
features.description: Allows employees to view their profile, establish manager relations, and review current attendance status.
user_flows: GET /employee/profile with a valid employee JWT -> Receive 200 with user profile and EmployeeProfile including department and shift details
GET /employee/profile without a valid JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error
POST /employee/set-manager with a valid employee JWT and manager data -> Receive 201 with relation updated confirmation
POST /employee/set-manager with an invalid manager reference -> Receive error response indicating the relation cannot be created
GET /employee/today-status with a valid employee JWT -> Receive 200 with today's status report including attendance and shift information
GET /employee/today-status with an expired JWT -> Receive 401/403 authorization error
